title: Gradio AI工作流：连接、运行与部署指南
summary: 本文是Hugging Face官方博客发布的一篇关于使用Gradio构建和部署AI工作流的实用指南。文章以“Wire It, Run It, Deploy It”为主线，系统介绍了Gradio作为AI应用开发框架的核心功能与最佳实践。内容涵盖：如何通过Gradio的组件化设计将多个AI模型（如文本生成、图像识别、语音处理等）串联成复杂的工作流；利用Gradio的接口（Interface）和块（Blocks）API实现灵活的交互逻辑；以及如何将构建好的工作流快速部署到Hugging Face Spaces或本地服务器，实现共享与生产级应用。文章还强调了Gradio在简化前端开发、支持多模态输入输出、实时流式响应等方面的优势，并提供了实际代码示例和部署配置建议。整体而言，该指南旨在帮助开发者降低AI应用开发门槛，加速从原型到生产的转化过程，适合数据科学家、机器学习工程师及对AI应用开发感兴趣的开发者阅读。
summary_en: This article is an official Hugging Face blog post providing a practical guide to building and deploying AI workflows using Gradio. It follows the theme 'Wire It, Run It, Deploy It' and systematically introduces Gradio's core features and best practices as an AI application development framework. The content covers how to chain multiple AI models (e.g., text generation, image recognition, speech processing) into complex workflows using Gradio's component-based design; how to implement flexible interaction logic using Gradio's Interface and Blocks APIs; and how to quickly deploy the built workflows to Hugging Face Spaces or local servers for sharing and production-level use. The article also highlights Gradio's advantages in simplifying frontend development, supporting multimodal input/output, and real-time streaming responses, along with practical code examples and deployment configuration tips. Overall, the guide aims to lower the barrier to AI application development and accelerate the transition from prototype to production, making it suitable for data scientists, ML engineers, and developers interested in AI app development.
